event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: ITA 2915 was represented by Gabriele Bruni (tactician)
The Race Committee was represented by Marc Capo (pin end starting mark crew).
ITA 2915 presented tracking evidence of the incident.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Race 1 for ORC B was started under flag P as the preparatory signal.

During the last seconds before the starting signal, ITA 2915 and 3 other boats crossed the starting line and covered the view of the Race Committee members from the pin end towards the Race Committee signal vessel.
At the starting signal, the Race Committee members on the pin end starting mark identified ITA 2915's hull on the course side of the starting line.
The Race Committee signalled an individual recall and called ITA 2915's sail number twice by VHF as one of the boats being identified as OCS.
ITA 2915 did not return to the pre-start side of the starting line.
The Race Committee scored ITA 2915 as OCS in race 1.
conclusions: A part of ITA 2915's hull was identified on the course side of the starting line at the starting signal and she was properly scored OCS in accordance with RRS 29.1.
There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the Race Committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
